implementation.behavior: Text requests with a positive max_completion_tokens reserve a conservative input-byte-plus-overhead and output-token ceiling, capped by the reviewed per-model maximum. Unbounded and non-text requests retain the full reviewed model ceiling.

strategyChange: The failed USD 50 full-model reservation was not retried. The deployed code now derives a request-bounded text reservation and was verified with an injected stop at the reservation boundary, proving zero Provider calls.
remainingGate: A new explicit authorization is required before any ordinary-account model-chain or final-film run.
